policy: Every moderate advisory defaults to unresolved and blocks release approval until advisory-specific owner review. Every stored entry requires decision, reason, owner, reviewedAt and lockSha256 matching the current lockfile, including entries for absent advisories. Remediated means absent from the complete all-severity audit: a still-present advisory fails the audit gate regardless of severity. Remediation is not risk acceptance. Review and rebind entries after lockfile changes.
